title: *5 MINUTE* CHOCOLATE CRUNCH CAKE #shorts
description:
Episode 6 of MICROWAVE MAGIC✨a series where I make your favourite desserts at home only in a microwave 🙌🏻 Weekend dessert all sorted with 5 minutes, a microwave & this CHOCOLATE CRUNCH CAKE 🍫✨
Soft, rich, chocolatey with that perfect crunch on top, this is your sign to make this decadent dessert now 🥰

Ingredients
For the cake
½ cup milk
1 tsp vinegar
6 tbsp sugar
¼ cup sunflower oil
½ cup all purpose flour
¼ cup cocoa powder
½ tsp baking powder
½ tsp baking soda
For the soak
¼ cup warm water
1 tbsp instant coffee powder
For the ganache
1 cup dark chocolate
1 cup cream
For the cornflakes layer
1 cup cornflakes
1 cup milk chocolate, melted

Instructions
1. Add milk and vinegar in a bowl and give it a quick mix. Let the mixture rest for 5 mins to curdle.
⁠2. Add sugar and oil to the above mixture and whisk until nicely combined.
⁠3. Sift in the all purpose flour, cocoa powder, baking powder and baking soda and mix only until no flour pockets remain.
⁠4. Pour the batter in your oval glass dish and microwave for 3.5 minutes.
⁠5. For the chocolate ganache, add chopped chocolate in a bowl and pour hot cream over it. Mix it well to make smooth chocolate ganache.
⁠6. Once the cake is ready, soak it with espresso and pour chocolate ganache over it.
⁠7. Mix cornflakes with melted milk chocolate and coat the cornflakes completely.
⁠8. Spread an evenly layer of this mixture over the ganache and let the chocolate set before serving.
